user.title: Connect to Dietly
user.description: Sign in to your Dietly account. Active orders and diets will be discovered automatically.

reconfigure.title: Update Dietly password
reconfigure.description: Enter a new password for the same Dietly account. To switch accounts, remove and add the integration again.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Dietly again
reauth_confirm.description: The Dietly session expired or was rejected. Enter your password to resume updates.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Dietly. Check the connection and Home Assistant log.
error.wrong_account: The credentials belong to a different Dietly account.
error.account_already_configured: This Dietly account is already configured in another entry.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Dietly account is already configured.
